headline: This law lengthens the agreement period for Medicare home-based medical practices in the Independence at Home demonstration from three years to five years.
what_it_does: The law changes the Medicare Independence at Home Medical Practice Demonstration Program. Before this law, a participating practice signed an agreement that lasted three years. Under this law, the agreement lasts five years. The summary does not describe other changes to the program.

who_it_affects.group: Medical practices that take part in the Independence at Home demonstration program
who_it_affects.how: Their agreements with Medicare now run for five years instead of three.

who_it_affects.group: Medicare beneficiaries who receive care through these participating practices
who_it_affects.how: Their practice's program agreement can now last longer, but the summary does not say how this changes their care or coverage.

when_it_takes_effect: The summary does not give a separate effective date. The law was enacted on July 30, 2015.
